candidate.answerReason: The midpoint conditions halve both dimensions, so the smaller rectangle has one quarter of the given area: 72/4 = 18.

methods.label: Halve both dimensions
methods.explanation:
The adjacent sides of rectangle \(DEFG\) are \(DE\) and \(DG\). Since \(E\) and \(G\) are midpoints,
\[
DE=\frac{AD}{2},\qquad DG=\frac{CD}{2}.
\]
A rectangle's area is the product of its adjacent side lengths. Halving both lengths therefore divides the area by \(4\):
\[
\operatorname{Area}(DEFG)
=\frac{AD}{2}\cdot\frac{CD}{2}
=\frac{AD\cdot CD}{4}
=\frac{72}{4}=18.
\]
The area is \(18\) square meters, choice \(\boxed{D}\).
